title: tree-sitter 0.25.10 → 0.27.0 in the osf crate
summary: A dependency bump: the `osf` crate pins `tree-sitter` from `=0.25.10` to `=0.27.0`, and `Cargo.lock` is regenerated to match. The new release drops the transitive `regex-syntax` dependency from the tree-sitter package, so the resolved graph loses one crate while the parser API surface the `osf` crate consumes stays the same. Nothing in the source changes; the blast radius is the lockfile, the build, and every consumer of the `osf` crate that links the parser.
